description: Preview (may change before v0.10.0): Coordinate agents sharing one checkout. record leaves an expiring note in .fixmap/intents/ saying which files (optionally which line ranges) this agent plans to edit; list shows live intents; release removes one. Only .fixmap/intents/ is written; source files are never edited. Call fixmap_conflicts before editing to check for overlap.

agent.description: record: this agent's id (letters, numbers, dot, dash, underscore)

contracts.description: record: contract files the change touches

edits.description: record: files to edit, each a repository-relative path or { path, ranges: [{ start, end }] }

format.description: Output format: markdown (default) or json, case-insensitive

id.description: record: intent id to create or replace; release: the intent to remove

impacts.description: record: files the change may affect but will not edit

repo.description: Local repository path, defaults to the server working directory

task.description: record: one line saying what the agent is doing

ttlMinutes.description: record: minutes until the intent expires (default 120, max 10080)

name: fixmap_intent
title: FixMap agent intents
